claim_text: Synthetic cold-spell days generated from two custodians (heatpumpmonitor.org UK, WPuQ Germany) lower heat-pump peak-demand MAE in the coldest 5 percent of hours on the held-out third custodian (HEAPO households with a separate heat-pump meter) below BOTH real-only training and a simulation-pretrained transfer baseline of the RESCAST-100K kind.
reason: real-only baseline not beaten (upper bound 0.02917 kW >= 0); simulation-pretrained transfer baseline not beaten (upper bound 0.01851 kW >= 0); memorisation audit fails for seed(s) [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
note: The claim is stated and argued in the companion paper; the release carries only these pooled numbers (aggregated over at least 50 held-out households).
